text:
maria-mkt: Quick kickoff — we need a crisp pass on landing copy for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private that ties to launch posts + webinar funnel. Goal: one coherent narrative for the next two weeks.
noah-growth: Love it. Would be great to surface benchmark claims early (latency, cost delta) so we can use them in launch posts.
akira-copy: Agree. Suggest: headline focus on predictable inference (latency + cost), subhead explains deployment modes. Short bullets for dev benefits.
jamal-ux: UI note — make sure the CTA flow differs by mode: Hosted -> "Get started", Dedicated -> "Request capacity", Private -> "Contact sales / evals". Keeps conversion clean.
olivia-ops: For inbound routing: Hosted signups -> growth flow; Dedicated interest -> SDR; Private -> AE + security packet. Can we annotate routes in copy doc?
maria-mkt: Yes. I'll add a routing matrix in the page copy doc. Also, webinar tie-in: a 30-min product demo + benchmark walk through. Wants 1 rapid demo, 1 deep dive slide for Dedicated/Private.
noah-growth: Webinar promo posts: 3 launch posts — announcement, benchmark teaser, roadmap/deep-dive invite. Each with distinct CTA mapping to the routing matrix.
akira-copy: Draft microcopy for each post and the hero variations:
```
Hero Hosted: "Ship production LLM features in minutes — predictable latency, pay-as-you-go."
Hero Dedicated: "Reserved capacity for predictable throughput and SLAs."
Hero Private: "On-prem & VPC deployments for regulated workloads."
```
noah-growth: Nice. For benchmark teaser: include a one-line stat e.g., "Up to 3x lower serving cost with batching + caching" — need approval from eng.
maria-mkt: @deploy-bot can you ping eng-bench for confirmation?
deploy-bot: pinging #eng-ml for benchmark signoff (automated): <https://slack.com/archives/eng-ml|eng-ml thread created> :robot_face:
jamal-ux: Also add a short explainer card on the page about fallbacks/routing: helps PMs understand reliability story.
akira-copy: For webinar signups, we'll include a short prompt asking about use-case (prototype vs regulated prod) to route followups. Keeps SDRs contextual.
olivia-ops: Good — include a hidden form field so we auto-tag inbound leads in CRM. I'll set tagging rules: hosted_tag, dedicated_tag, private_tag.
maria-mkt: Action list: 1) Akira — initial copy drafts for hero + subhead + 3 post variants (due EOD tomorrow). 2) Jamal — CTA mapping and wire note for forms (due tomorrow). 3) Olivia — CRM tagging rules + routing doc (due EOD Wed). 4) Noah — social calendar + webinar promo cadence. 5) Deploy-bot -> eng-ml bench signoff.
noah-growth: I'll draft the promo calendar. Recommend promo cadence: Day 0 announcement, Day 3 teaser (bench), Day 7 webinar reminder, Day 10 follow-up blog + recording.
akam: (typo)
akira-copy: On it. I'll attach copy as short snippets to the doc so they can be A/B tested. We should test two hero tones: product-led (technical) vs benefit-led (business).
maria-mkt: Perfect. We'll run quick 2-arm hero test in first 48 hours of launch. Keep copy delta small.
noah-growth: Anything else? budget for paid ads?
maria-mkt: Keep organic first — if webinar signups hit target we escalate to paid.
jamal-ux: I'll mock the three CTA flows in Figma and link back.
olivia-ops: I'll coordinate SDR shift for webinar followups.
maria-mkt: Cool. Next sync Friday 10am to review drafts. Thanks team :tada:
